answer_verification.reasoning: On an ordinary die the opposite pairs are(1,6),(2,5),(3,4). Three faces meeting at a vertex cannot contain both members of an opposite pair. A has2and5,B has4and3,C has3and4,D has1and6,so all impossible. E has6,2,4,onefromeachoppositepair, which can be assigned to three perpendicular positive normals with remaining1,5,3 on their negatives. HenceE.
